verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support hybrid search mode (searchMode: 'hybrid'), metadata filtering by custom properties like category/status/date, container-tag scoping, and multiple retrieval paths (document search/RAG, memory graph traversal, user profiles) rather than a single fixed similarity search. Reranking is not explicitly documented as a separate developer-facing lever, and no independent hands-on corroboration of filter/hybrid quality exists. missing for 10: explicit reranking control, independent/hands-on validation of retrieval steering.
